title: Oozy Thai Cheese Pilaf
description: Buttery, cheesy, and packed with the flavors of Northern Thailand, this dish is sure to impress. The perfect combination of sweet and savory, it's a meal that's both comforting and exciting.

ingredients.name: Grated cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: Low-fat or reduced-fat for a healthier option.

instructions: Heat the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat until melted and foamy.
Add the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until lightly golden and fragrant.
Slowly pour in the confit tomato, stirring continuously to prevent lumps from forming.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened and sauce-like.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Stir in the cheddar and mozzarella cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the currants, fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and vegetable oil. Stir to combine.
Stir in the cooked basmati rice until well coated with the sauce.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish or individual ramekins.
Use a spatula to create a well in the center of each serving and crack an egg yolk into it.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10-15 minutes, or until the egg yolk is cooked to your desired doneness.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
